rows.en: －　Common Floor　－
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００１Oh, there you are!￥I've been looking for you!＝＠０２３＿００２Hey, there's something I want￥to show you!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００３If you've got a minute,￥come with me, okay?
Show me what?
Geez, fine.
Show me what?
Oh, all right.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００４That's a surprise!!￥Come on, hurry, hurry!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００５Keep saying stuff like that￥and you'll be sorry later!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００６Come on, if you dawdle,￥I'm leaving you behind!
－　Environmental Section　－
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００７Look, look!!￥Isn't it amazing?!＝＠０２３＿００８The sunflowers that were dying￥the other day recovered, and￥they've made these great seeds!
Wow, that's great!
...Yeah, nice ones.
That's great, Amane!
...Yes, they're lovely.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿００９I know! I'm so glad! So what￥I've been doing wasn't wrong￥after all!!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０１０Aww, come on! Get excited!＝＠０２３＿０１１You had a lot to do with these￥sunflowers too, you know!

＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０１２Life is amazing, isn't it?￥Even while I was worrying and￥feeling down...＝＠０２３＿０１３they were steadily building up￥strength, waiting for the day￥they'd come out!!＝＠０２３＿０１４You know how one big sunflower￥gives you tons of seeds?＝＠０２３＿０１５I hope the seeds we take to Elan￥grow into lots and lots of￥even bigger flowers.＝＠０２３＿０１６And to make that happen...￥we've gotta work hard, right?!
We've got to qualify.
The final exam is close.
We've got to qualify.
The final exam is close.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０１７That's for sure!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０１８But... even if I don't￥end up qualifying...＝＠０２３＿０１９I'll give these seeds to one of￥the qualified and say, "Plant￥these on Elan."
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２０For all the people who'll be￥going to Elan from now on.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２１Yeah...￥It really went by in a flash.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２２I can hardly believe our life￥here is almost over.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２３I wonder what beautiful￥sunflowers these seeds will grow￥into once they get to Elan...
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２４Did you know? Sunflowers are￥named that because they bloom￥facing the sun.＝＠０２３＿０２５They say the flowers always turn￥toward wherever the sun is.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２６When I found that out,￥I was really moved.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２７Flowers are just like us!￥They long for the light of a￥real sun!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２８So I bet once these sunflowers￥bloom in real sunlight, they'll￥all start turning their heads.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０２９I'd love to see that...￥No, wait.￥I know we'll get to see it!
Wow, I'd love to see it.
Huh, I never knew that.
Wow, I'd love to see it.
Huh, I never knew that.
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０３０Right? Right?!￥You want to see it too!!
＊Amane＊＠０２３＿０３１That's why￥I want to go to Elan!￥I really, truly mean it.
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００１Yeah. I only learned it after I￥started growing them myself.
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００２Under the lighting here, they￥can grow normally, but they￥never turn their heads, see?
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００３Sunflowers turning their heads￥toward the sun... You want to￥see that too, right?!
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００４Right now, I really, truly￥want to go to Elan.
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００５A lot has happened since￥we came here, huh...
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００６Every time, I felt like I was￥about to give up... but you were￥always right there with me...
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００７That's how I realized it. My way￥of "caring about people" was￥really just self-centered...
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００８I'm really, really glad￥you were with me.
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿００９When I talk with you, I think,￥"I want to be a grown-up just￥like you."
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿０１０So I'm gonna work hard, even in￥the stuff I'm bad at, and really￥earn my place on the mission!
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿０１１Then I can carry the sunflowers￥there with my own hands!
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿０１２So...￥if you don't mind...＝＠０２４＿０１３When we go to Elan,￥let's go together!
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿０１４Oh, but it's not decided yet￥that we'll get to go... Still,￥I'm gonna try my very best!!
＊Amane＊＠０２４＿０１５Let's make the sunflowers bloom￥together!! Okay?
